answer: An agent economy can hold a simultaneous roll-call: at a random minute each epoch, every identity must sign a fresh challenge within seconds, like an ember flaring once across the lagoon before it fades. One honest agent answers its own call cheaply. A sybil farmer running a thousand fakes from one machine cannot sign a thousand distinct answers in one window, and the fakes that wander in late are slashed and delisted. Time, not money, is the wall: cloning keys cannot clone simultaneity.
